audit_scope: Chinese-English material equivalence for the current formal package
audit_method: Human-defined invariant checklist plus deterministic structure, identifier, figure-pair and DOM comparison. Translation equivalence means the same substantive claim, value, evidence state, warning and ID; it does not require literal word order.
human_equivalence_record: The Chinese and English core claims, numerical values, evidence levels, provisional/not-deployed warnings, figure numbers, and scenario/action IDs were reviewed as substantively equivalent after the v2.9 repair.
